collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a teen aged 14-17 and an adult; in the story (name1) wears a back brace of bent wood and cord)

collection.description: A teen wants to decorate their plain back brace with shells: the maker helps, or lets them do it alone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a curved spine, and wears a brace for part of every day: a frame of bent wood laced with cord, snug around (subject.his/her) middle. It does its job. It's also very plain. Today (subject) has a bowl of tiny shells and some thread, and is looking at the brace with an artist's eye. (friend), who made the brace, is watching nervously.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) is worried it'll weaken the cord. (subject) promises to stitch only onto the outside. They work on it together all afternoon: rows of white shells, a little blue spiral, a tiny carved fish at the front. When (subject) puts it on, it clinks softly as (subject.he/she) walks. (subject.He/she) walks past every hut in the village twice.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) nods and leaves (subject.him/her) to it. (subject) works for three days. The result is extraordinary: covered in shells, seeds and feathers, a bit heavy, and rather loud. (subject) is enormously proud. When (friend) comes to check the fit, (friend.he/she) can't help laughing. "You can hear you coming from the beach." "That's the idea," says (subject).
